DeepSeek just dropped V4.1‑Flash‑1017, and the latency drop is hard to ignore.

- The model swaps standard attention for Flash Attention 2, shaving off up to 40 % inference time on a single A100.  
- Parameter count stays at 7 B, but the quant‑aware fine‑tuning pushes the sweet spot between quality and cost—benchmark scores now sit within 0.3 % of the 13 B baseline while using half the GPU memory.  
- Open‑source licensing means I can spin up a local endpoint for rapid prototyping without the usual cloud bill shock.

I’m curious: will the community adopt Flash‑enabled LLMs as the new default, or will the extra engineering overhead keep them niche?
